title: नवाधिकशततमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 109 · The great path of dharma

summary.en: Yudhishthira says that the path of dharma has many branches and asks what is the best, and Bhishma tells him to be truthful and speak what is pleasant and true. He teaches the life of the one who is moderate in food and who serves his elders.
summary.kn: ಧರ್ಮಮಾರ್ಗ ಅನೇಕ ಶಾಖೆಗಳ ಮಹಾಮಾರ್ಗ, ಯಾವುದು ಶ್ರೇಷ್ಠವೆಂದು ಯುಧಿಷ್ಠಿರ ಕೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಸತ್ಯವಂತನಾಗಿ ಪ್ರಿಯ, ಸತ್ಯ ಮಾತನಾಡಬೇಕೆಂದು ಭೀಷ್ಮ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಮಿತಾಹಾರಿ, ಹಿರಿಯರ ಸೇವೆ ಮಾಡುವವನ ಜೀವನವನ್ನು ಬೋಧಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: युधिष्ठिर कहते हैं कि धर्म का मार्ग बहुशाखा वाला महापथ है और पूछते हैं कि श्रेष्ठ क्या है, और भीष्म कहते हैं कि सत्यवादी रहो और प्रिय तथा सत्य बोलो। वे मिताहारी और बड़ों की सेवा करने वाले का जीवन सिखाते हैं।
summary.te: ధర్మ మార్గం అనేక శాఖల మహామార్గమని, ఏది శ్రేష్ఠమని యుధిష్ఠిరుడు అడుగుతాడు; సత్యవంతుడై ప్రియంగా, సత్యంగా మాట్లాడాలని భీష్ముడు అంటాడు. మితాహారి, పెద్దలను సేవించేవాని జీవితాన్ని బోధిస్తాడు.
summary.ta: தர்ம வழி பல கிளைகள் கொண்ட பெருவழி, எது சிறந்தது என்று யுதிஷ்டிரர் கேட்க, உண்மையாளனாக இனியதும் உண்மையுமானதைப் பேச வேண்டும் என்று பீஷ்மர் கூறுகிறார். மிதமாக உண்டு பெரியோருக்குப் பணிவிடை செய்பவனின் வாழ்வைப் போதிக்கிறார்.
summary.ml: ധർമ്മത്തിന്റെ വഴിക്ക് പല ശാഖകളുണ്ടെന്നും, ഏതാണ് ഉത്തമമെന്നും യുധിഷ്ഠിരൻ പറയുന്നു; സത്യസന്ധനാകണമെന്നും, ഇഷ്ടകരവും സത്യവുമായത് പറയണമെന്നും ഭീഷ്മർ പറയുന്നു. ഭക്ഷണത്തിൽ മിതത്വം പാലിക്കുന്നവന്റെയും മുതിർന്നവരെ സേവിക്കുന്നവന്റെയും ജീവിതം അദ്ദേഹം പഠിപ്പിക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 12.109; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Wed Jun 16 2021

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
महानयं धर्मपथो बहुशाखश्च भारत ।
किं स्विदेवेह धर्माणामनुष्ठेयतमं मतम् ॥

meaning.en: This path of dharma is great and has many branches, Bharata. Which of the duties is considered the most worth doing here?

verses.text:
किं कार्यं सर्वधर्माणां गरीयो भवतो मतम् ।
यथायं पुरुषो धर्ममिह च प्रेत्य चाप्नुयात् ॥

meaning.en: What is the weightiest act of all duties in your view, by which a man may gain dharma both here and hereafter?

verses.text: भीष्म उवाच

meaning.en: Bhishma said:

verses.text:
मातापित्रोर्गुरूणां च पूजा बहुमता मम ।
अत्र युक्तो नरो लोकान्यशश्च महदश्नुते ॥

meaning.en: I hold in high regard the worship of mother, father and teachers; a man devoted to this gains the worlds and great fame.

verses.text:
यदेते ह्यभिजानीयुः कर्म तात सुपूजिताः ।
धर्म्यं धर्मविरुद्धं वा तत्कर्तव्यं युधिष्ठिर ॥

meaning.en: Whatever act they approve when they are well honoured, my son, righteous or not, that must be done, Yudhishthira.

verses.text:
न तैरनभ्यनुज्ञातो धर्ममन्यं प्रकल्पयेत् ।
यमेतेऽभ्यनुजानीयुः स धर्म इति निश्चयः ॥

meaning.en: Without their leave one should not devise another dharma; whatever they approve is certainly dharma.

verses.text:
एत एव त्रयो लोका एत एवाश्रमास्त्रयः ।
एत एव त्रयो वेदा एत एव त्रयोऽग्नयः ॥

meaning.en: These three are the three worlds, these the three stages of life, these the three Vedas, and these the three fires.

verses.text:
पिता ह्यग्निर्गार्हपत्यो माताग्निर्दक्षिणः स्मृतः ।
गुरुराहवनीयस्तु साग्नित्रेता गरीयसी ॥

meaning.en: The father is the Garhapatya fire, the mother is called the Dakshina fire, and the teacher is the Ahavaniya; this triad of fires is the more weighty.

verses.text:
त्रिष्वप्रमाद्यन्नेतेषु त्रीँल्लोकानवजेष्यसि ।
पितृवृत्त्या त्विमं लोकं मातृवृत्त्या तथापरम् ।
ब्रह्मलोकं गुरोर्वृत्त्या नित्यमेव चरिष्यसि ॥

meaning.en: If you are not careless toward these three, you will win the three worlds: this world by serving your father, the next by serving your mother, and the world of Brahma by serving your teacher, always.

verses.text:
सम्यगेतेषु वर्तस्व त्रिषु लोकेषु भारत ।
यशः प्राप्स्यसि भद्रं ते धर्मं च सुमहाफलम् ॥

meaning.en: Behave properly toward these three, Bharata, and you will gain fame and blessing and a dharma of great fruit.

verses.text:
नैतानतिशयेज्जातु नात्यश्नीयान्न दूषयेत् ।
नित्यं परिचरेच्चैव तद्वै सुकृतमुत्तमम् ।
कीर्तिं पुण्यं यशो लोकान्प्राप्स्यसे च जनाधिप ॥

meaning.en: One should never surpass them, nor eat more than they, nor slight them; one should always attend to them, for that is the best good deed. You will gain renown, merit, fame and worlds, king.

verses.text:
सर्वे तस्यादृता लोका यस्यैते त्रय आदृताः ।
अनादृतास्तु यस्यैते सर्वास्तस्याफलाः क्रियाः ॥

meaning.en: All the worlds are honoured by the one who honours these three; for one who does not honour them, all rites are fruitless.

verses.text:
नैवायं न परो लोकस्तस्य चैव परंतप ।
अमानिता नित्यमेव यस्यैते गुरवस्त्रयः ॥

meaning.en: Neither this world nor the next is for him, scourge of foes, whose three elders are always unhonoured.

verses.text:
न चास्मिन्न परे लोके यशस्तस्य प्रकाशते ।
न चान्यदपि कल्याणं पारत्रं समुदाहृतम् ॥

meaning.en: Neither here nor in the next world does fame shine for him, nor is any other good for the next world told of him.

verses.text:
तेभ्य एव तु तत्सर्वं कृत्यया विसृजाम्यहम् ।
तदासीन्मे शतगुणं सहस्रगुणमेव च ।
तस्मान्मे संप्रकाशन्ते त्रयो लोका युधिष्ठिर ॥

meaning.en: I gave all of it to them with devotion; it became for me a hundredfold and a thousandfold. Therefore the three worlds shine for me, Yudhishthira.

verses.text:
दशैव तु सदाचार्यः श्रोत्रियानतिरिच्यते ।
दशाचार्यानुपाध्याय उपाध्यायान्पिता दश ॥

meaning.en: A good teacher surpasses ten Vedic scholars; a preceptor surpasses ten teachers; a father surpasses ten preceptors.

verses.text:
पितॄन्दश तु मातैका सर्वां वा पृथिवीमपि ।
गुरुत्वेनाभिभवति नास्ति मातृसमो गुरुः ।
गुरुर्गरीयान्पितृतो मातृतश्चेति मे मतिः ॥

meaning.en: A mother alone surpasses ten fathers, or even the whole earth, in weight; there is no teacher like a mother. I hold that the mother is the heaviest teacher, heavier than the father.

verses.text:
उभौ हि मातापितरौ जन्मनि व्युपयुज्यतः ।
शरीरमेतौ सृजतः पिता माता च भारत ।
आचार्यशिष्टा या जातिः सा दिव्या साजरामरा ॥

meaning.en: Both mother and father serve in one's birth; they make the body, Bharata. But the birth given by the teacher is divine, ageless and deathless.

verses.text:
अवध्या हि सदा माता पिता चाप्यपकारिणौ ।
न संदुष्यति तत्कृत्वा न च ते दूषयन्ति तम् ।
धर्माय यतमानानां विदुर्देवाः सहर्षिभिः ॥

meaning.en: A mother and a father who do wrong must still never be killed; he is not stained by doing so, nor do they stain him; the gods and sages know this of those who strive for dharma.

verses.text:
य आवृणोत्यवितथेन कर्णा-
वृतं ब्रुवन्नमृतं संप्रयच्छन् ।
तं वै मन्ये पितरं मातरं च
तस्मै न द्रुह्येत्कृतमस्य जानन् ॥

meaning.en: One who fills the ears with truth, speaking right and giving the immortal: him I regard as father and mother; one should not harm him, remembering what he has done.

verses.text:
विद्यां श्रुत्वा ये गुरुं नाद्रियन्ते
प्रत्यासन्नं मनसा कर्मणा वा ।
यथैव ते गुरुभिर्भावनीया-
स्तथा तेषां गुरवोऽप्यर्चनीयाः ॥

meaning.en: Those who, having heard knowledge, do not respect the teacher who is near them in mind or deed: just as they should be honoured by their own teachers, so their teachers too should be honoured.

verses.text:
तस्मात्पूजयितव्याश्च संविभज्याश्च यत्नतः ।
गुरवोऽर्चयितव्याश्च पुराणं धर्ममिच्छता ॥

meaning.en: So, one who wants the ancient dharma should honour teachers with effort, share with them, and revere them.

verses.text:
येन प्रीताश्च पितरस्तेन प्रीतः पितामहः ।
प्रीणाति मातरं येन पृथिवी तेन पूजिता ॥

meaning.en: By what pleases the father, the grandfather is pleased; by what pleases the mother, the earth is honoured.

verses.text:
येन प्रीणात्युपाध्यायं तेन स्याद्ब्रह्म पूजितम् ।
मातृतः पितृतश्चैव तस्मात्पूज्यतमो गुरुः ।
ऋषयश्च हि देवाश्च प्रीयन्ते पितृभिः सह ॥

meaning.en: By what pleases the teacher, Brahman is honoured. Therefore the teacher is more to be honoured than mother or father; and sages and gods are pleased together with the ancestors.

verses.text:
न केनचन वृत्तेन ह्यवज्ञेयो गुरुर्भवेत् ।
न च माता न च पिता तादृशो यादृशो गुरुः ॥

meaning.en: The teacher should never be slighted by any conduct; neither mother nor father is as the teacher is.

verses.text:
न तेऽवमानमर्हन्ति न च ते दूषयन्ति तम् ।
गुरूणामेव सत्कारं विदुर्देवाः सहर्षिभिः ॥

meaning.en: They do not deserve contempt, nor do they stain him; the gods with the sages know the respect due to teachers.

verses.text:
उपाध्यायं पितरं मातरं च
येऽभिद्रुह्यन्ति मनसा कर्मणा वा ।
तेषां पापं भ्रूणहत्याविशिष्टं
तस्मान्नान्यः पापकृदस्ति लोके ॥

meaning.en: Those who wrong a teacher, father or mother in mind or deed bear a sin worse than killing an embryo; there is no other sinner in the world like them.

verses.text:
मित्रद्रुहः कृतघ्नस्य स्त्रीघ्नस्य पिशुनस्य च ।
चतुर्णां वयमेतेषां निष्कृतिं नानुशुश्रुमः ॥

meaning.en: For one who betrays a friend, an ungrateful man, a killer of a woman, and a slanderer, we have not heard of atonement for these four.

verses.text:
एतत्सर्वमतिदेशेन सृष्टं
यत्कर्तव्यं पुरुषेणेह लोके ।
एतच्छ्रेयो नान्यदस्माद्विशिष्टं
सर्वान्धर्माननुसृत्यैतदुक्तम् ॥

meaning.en: All this has been set out by way of extension, whatever a man should do in this world; this is the highest good and nothing is better than this; it has been said after following all the dharmas.
